line: Most think you need to know how to code.
That's wrong. You don't need to write any code at all.
You just say what you want, in plain words.
Like this: make the button big. No code. No hard words.
This exact website, the one you're looking at, was built this way.
Every page here is proof. Someone described it, and the tool wrote it.
Start with one sentence and one small change, before anything big.
The setup's in the link in bio.
Follow for setups that actually works.
